component.name: XenonStream
component.summary: XenonStream is an open-source cross-platform client for Xbox Remote Play and Xbox Cloud Gaming (xCloud)

description.p: XenonStream is an open-source cross-platform client for Xbox Remote Play and Xbox Cloud Gaming (xCloud) with 1440p streaming, HEVC/AV1 codecs, Linux VA-API & Wayland support, AMD FSR 1.0 / CAS (WebGL2), RTX VSR passthrough & Clarity Boost, LAN host-first routing, encrypted multi-account storage, 4-player local co-op, and an F9 draggable real-time FPS HUD.

ul.li: Initial standalone cross-platform release of XenonStream for Windows, Linux (AppImage/DEB/Flatpak), Steam Deck, and macOS (Universal DMG).

720p / 1080p / 1440p streaming, H.264 / HEVC (H.265) / AV1 codec selection with RTX/FEC resilience, AMD FSR 1.0 / CAS (WebGL2) + RTX VSR passthrough + Clarity Boost with live switcher, and LAN host-first UDP routing.
Obsidian Neon Emerald-Cyan UI, instant-collapse top stream bar chevron, viewport-safe F9 draggable 36px green FPS HUD, 4-player co-op, Touch Overlay, Discord RPC, 13 locales, and Electron 45.3.4.
